title: The Olive Oil Polyphenol Index: Every Brand That Publishes Its Polyphenol Numbers (2025/26 Harvest)
seoTitle: Olive Oil Polyphenol Index: Brands That Publish Their Numbers
excerpt: Very few olive oil producers publish their polyphenol content. This index lists every brand we found that does, with the measured values, the analysis method and whether the lab report is viewable. Ranked by documented oleocanthal and oleacein, because totals from different methods are different currencies.
seoDescription: Every olive oil brand that publishes its polyphenol numbers, ranked by oleocanthal and oleacein, with method, lab reports and why totals can't be compared.
